name: HALCYON requirements baseline ingestion contract

formats.format: UTF-8 CSV with JSON-encoded array/object cells and a JSON metadata sidecar
formats.nativeConformance: This is an export/ingestion transport. DI-MGMT-82133A §2 requires a relational database; CSV alone does not satisfy that requirement.

reqif.reason: Metadata-only reference in Batch 0. No SDO clause extraction and no unverified ReqIF conformance assertion. A future adapter requires an independently verified licensed format profile.

cadence: Each approved baseline and each approved change; local integration choice, not a universal government delivery cadence.

keys.identityPolicy: Opaque IDs are never reused. A wording change changes wordingSHA256 and creates a new immutable baseline version; it does not silently reassign the requirement ID. Split obligations receive new IDs with predecessor links in change history.

fields.name: rows[].baselineId
fields.description: Stable identifier of the delivered baseline; local primary-key component.

fields.name: rows[].requirementId
fields.description: Project-unique requirement identifier; stable across wording changes and never reassigned to another obligation.

fields.name: rows[].wbsId
fields.description: Explicit join to an entry in the separately controlled HALCYON F5 WBS dictionary. Mandatory here by user integration rule, not an invented DID field.

fields.name: rows[].tier
fields.description: Normalized hierarchy level 0..3; source tier-specific ID/text columns become one row per requirement.

fields.name: rows[].requirementTitle
fields.description: Short subject identification.

fields.name: rows[].requirementText
fields.description: Imported authoritative requirement wording; source text is not silently rewritten. A derived review wording belongs in a separately versioned record.

fields.name: rows[].sourceDocumentId
fields.description: Exact source document identifier, retained with its edition.

fields.name: rows[].sourceDocumentTitle
fields.description: Source document title.

fields.name: rows[].sourceEdition
fields.description: Explicit source edition; never replaced automatically with the current catalog edition.

fields.name: rows[].sourceParagraph
fields.description: Source paragraph locator, independent from the opaque requirement identifier.

fields.name: rows[].sourcePassage
fields.description: Verbatim source passage; the three sample rows have synthetic HALCYON passages, not government excerpts.

fields.name: rows[].sourcePassageSHA256
fields.description: Computed normalized digest of sourcePassage.

fields.name: rows[].wordingSHA256
fields.description: Computed normalized digest of requirementText.

fields.name: rows[].parentRequirementIds
fields.description: Explicit relationship endpoints; may be empty for documented top-level/derived requirements. This array is not the mandatory requirement join key.

fields.name: rows[].verificationMethods
fields.description: Source qualification/verification methods. Special is allowed by the SSS; the extraction record verificationIntent uses only the user-requested four-value enum.

fields.name: rows[].classification
fields.description: This public-demo profile accepts only UNCLASSIFIED; it does not certify that the document is properly marked or releasable.

fields.name: rows[].distributionStatement
fields.description: Source marking retained; public demo uses an explicit fictional-sample statement, not an invented government release approval.

fields.name: rows[].attributes
fields.description: Structured, profile-specific content. In CSV this object is encoded as a JSON string.

fields.name: rows[].stateModeIds
fields.description: Applicable state/mode links.

fields.name: rows[].sectionId
fields.description: Source requirement category or specification section.

fields.name: rows[].capabilityId
fields.description: Capability grouping identifier.

fields.name: rows[].interfaceId
fields.description: Project-unique interface identifier when relevant.

fields.name: rows[].criticality
fields.description: Source-defined requirement criticality; no invented universal scale.

csvDecoding.headerRule: Exactly the listed columns in the listed order; duplicate, missing, or unknown headers reject.
csvDecoding.blankCells: Blank optional cells are omitted from the decoded row. Blank required cells reject; an empty parent-link array is encoded as [] rather than a blank cell.
csvDecoding.integerCells: tier is parsed as a base-10 integer 0..3; other IDs and version values remain strings.
csvDecoding.jsonCells: parentRequirementIds, verificationMethods, stateModeIds are JSON arrays; attributes is a JSON object. Reject malformed JSON and duplicate JSON member names.
csvDecoding.stringCells: Every other cell remains a string, including numeric-looking WBS/requirement IDs.
csvDecoding.recordOrder: Source order is retained until canonicalization, then sorted by primary key.

profilePaths.sss: Document-level SSS title/index/tailoring and other content, per record conditions.
profilePaths.rtvm: RTVM cover/change history/database description/relationships/dictionary. Not supplied as fictitious contractor identity or contract number.
profilePaths.references: Exact document edition registry, independent of the current catalog.

lookupCatalogAuthority: Sample joinCatalogs are demonstration fixtures. In operational ingestion the receiver uses independently controlled F5 and requirement registries; an incoming file cannot approve its own new join targets.
markings: Carry classification and distributionStatement on every row and in metadata; preserve original source markings in the controlled source registry. This demo accepts only fictional public UNCLASSIFIED material. Marking validation and a digest do not prove release authority or detect all sensitive information. No CUI storage/control claim is made.

localRules.rule: Reject every row missing either requirementId or wbsId; resolve both keys against the controlled requirement registry and F5 WBS index.
Require unique (baselineId, requirementId), explicit source identity/edition/paragraph, and one declared public-demo marking profile.
Compute SHA-256 using UTF-8, Unicode NFC, trim and Unicode-whitespace collapse, no final newline, lowercase hexadecimal; never treat a digest as proof of authenticity or compliance.

Accept only explicitly public fictional sample data. Reject declared CUI/classified/export-restricted/proprietary content. Labels and attestation cannot guarantee safe content; no automatic marking classification is claimed.
Validate CSV parsing, JSON-encoded cells, required fields, references, and normalized hashes before accepting a drop. Keep source applicability review separate from transport validation.
Receive each approved baseline and each approved change; retain immutable prior snapshots. No universal monthly or real-time source cadence is asserted.

acceptance.rule: Reject metadata that fails metadataSchema; reject rows whose baselineId differs from metadata.baselineId.
Reject rows that fail rowSchema after CSV JSON-cell decoding.
Reject blank requirementId or wbsId on every row.
Reject a requirement join absent from the controlled requirement registry or a WBS join absent from the supplied controlled F5 index.
acceptance.check: row.requirementId IN catalogs.requirementIds AND row.wbsId IN catalogs.wbsIds

acceptance.rule: Reject parent links that do not resolve to a requirement in this drop or its declared external requirement registry. Empty parent lists remain valid for documented top-level/derived content.
Reject a supplied baseline hash that differs from the recomputed canonical snapshot hash.

Reject non-UNCLASSIFIED markings, failed public-fictional attestation, restrictive content declarations, or explicit contradictory restricted distribution labels. Content review remains necessary; this check cannot discover undisclosed sensitivity.
Warn that transport acceptance does not establish contractual SSS/RTVM/specification compliance. Applicable source-profile content and qualitative wording criteria require human review.

Warn when an applicable source profile lacks required metadata or field content, has missing tailoring decisions, or depends on an uninspected source. Do not promote to approved conformance until resolved.
Warn on guidance-only quality findings; do not reject a drop solely on an unadopted handbook statement.

canonicalForm: Decode CSV under this profile; reject duplicate columns and malformed JSON cells; preserve numeric types; reject non-finite numbers. NFC-normalize every string, trim, and collapse Unicode whitespace to one ASCII space. Sort rows lexicographically by (baselineId,requirementId). Serialize exactly {metadata,rows} with recursively sorted object keys, compact separators, UTF-8, literal Unicode, no trailing newline. Preserve array order. Do not include supplied hashes outside the row content, ingestion timestamps, or the baseline hash itself in the snapshot. Apply the task normalization once more to the resulting canonical JSON before SHA-256.
baselineHashScope: The included sample metadata plus the three included sample rows; verified against F1-baseline-snapshot.json. This digest is not a hash of the contract object or a signature.

mil-hdbk-539a.howThisFeedServesIt: Preserve source document identity, edition, paragraph, original passage, and stable requirement identity.
Join requirement records to WBS and explicit parent/verification links without replacing source authority.
Provide a controlled requirements-domain data contribution.
Generate filtered requirement views from a declared baseline.
Supply traceable review artifacts and verification-method metadata; content maturity is reviewed separately.
